description: Presidential Secretariat - Notifying that the Heading "Minister of Justice (No. 27)" published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 is amended by insertion of 03 items w.e.f. 27.04.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the assignment of functions to the Minister of Justice, specifically naming President Maithripala Sirisena as the authority making the change. It contains both the named individual (the President) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (adding matters relating to the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, supervision of organizations, and other specific subjects). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
